text:
sam-support: FYI — acme-corp reported rerank returning all 0.0 scores after we flipped their alias to 'beta-ranker'. Customer says it started after a config change this morning. attaching sample request/response. @priya.rao @mike-sre please triage.

priya.rao: Can you paste the exact request body and the model param they used? also tenant id so I can look up routing.

sam-support: tenant: acme-corp-42
Curl we got from them:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"prod-ranker-alias","queries":["how to reset password"],"documents":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```
response:
```json
{"scores":[0.0,0.0],"model":"prod-ranker-alias","status":"ok"}
```
They expected different top scores.

mike-sre: :eyes: That response shape is odd — we usually return nonzero floats. Could be a fallback to a meta-model that returns zeros on mismatch, or their client cached a deprecated alias that now maps to a placeholder. I'll check routing logs for acme-corp-42 between 08:45-09:05 UTC.

eng-runtime-bot: alias-resolve: prod-ranker-alias -> rerank-legacy-2020 (deprecated) at 2026-03-10T08:50:12Z
eng-runtime-bot: model-backend: rerank-legacy-2020 currently flagged 'deprecated' with return_mode: 'zero-on-unsupported-input'

priya.rao: aha — the alias resolved to a deprecated backend which intentionally returns zeros for unknown input shapes to avoid corrupt scores. That explains it. Did acme recently switch to a new request shape (e.g., different docs field length)?

sam-support: they did change docs from array of strings to an array of objects in their client last week (we asked them to update to the new API), but the client didn't update model param — they left the alias expecting the new behavior.

alex.chen: steps to repro locally: use tenant acme-corp-42, call alias 'prod-ranker-alias' with the new object-docs shape and you should see zeros. I reproduced.

priya.rao: quick mitigation: 1) ask customer to call canonical model id rerank-v3-quant (non-deprecated) OR 2) update alias mapping to point to rerank-v3-quant. Which approach do we want?

mike-sre: short-term: patch alias mapping (if customer approves) to avoid outage. long-term: we need clearer behavior when deprecated models are hit — returning zeros silently is dangerous. Escalating to eng-runtime for an alias-policy change. @eng-runtime-bot can you create an issue?

eng-runtime-bot: issue created: RUNTIME-2134 "Deprecated rerank backend returns silent zero scores on input-shape mismatch" assigned to @eng-runtime, priority P2.

sam-support: acme said they'll accept alias remap if we patch within the hour. Can one of you do the remap and notify me so I can confirm?

priya.rao: remapping now (will route alias -> rerank-v3-quant), invalidating alias-cache for acme-corp-42.

eng-runtime-bot: alias-update: prod-ranker-alias -> rerank-v3-quant applied at 2026-03-10T09:05:01Z by priya.rao

sam-support: patched and asked customer to retry. they reported back: scores look normal now, no more all-zero responses. :white_check_mark:

mike-sre: follow-ups: - add metric alert on sudden spike of all-zero rerank responses per-tenant - update docs to call out deprecated-model behavior - add a client-side warning when using aliases that resolve to deprecated backends

priya.rao: logging note: added extra debug logs on alias resolution with tenant id for 24h for further validation.

sam-support: closing the support escal; created internal KB entry summarizing steps to diagnose silent-zero rerank. tagging eng-runtime for follow-up.

alex.chen: KB link (internal): https://redwood.internal/kb/rerank-deprecated-zero-scores — please add any missing repro notes.

sam-support: thanks all :pray:
note: thread created for a rerank alias -> deprecated model resulting in silent zero scores; includes repro, logs, mitigation and follow-ups
